what: Armed groups launch coordinated attacks across Mali

clean_source_blocks.text: Witnesses report clashes in the centre and north, in what has been described as the largest jihadist attack in years.

LAGOS, Nigeria—In Mali, West Africa, armed groups including Islamist militants launched one of the largest coordinated attacks seen in recent years, targeting multiple cities across the country early Saturday.
Explosions and sustained gunfire were reported in Mali's capital, Bamako, as armed groups launched co-ordinated attacks across the country into Sunday.
Islamic militants and separatists attacked several locations in Mali’s capital and other cities on Saturday in one of the largest coordinated attacks in the country in recent years.
